prompt: Review ONLY candidate {target} in the upper-left TARGET panel of this aerial utility inspection board. The target is the visible pixels on gray OR the region inside the cyan contour. The upper-right and lower panels, when present, give context only. A target header by itself is not a visible selection. If there are no marked or isolated pixels, set target_present false and decision recheck. Power wires are elongated cables and may be faint, curved, parallel, or cross a car, road, pole, building or tree. Use keep when the marked selection follows a recognizable wire. Use background only when the selected shape clearly follows non-wire structures and has no plausible selected wire portion. Use recheck when the selection is unclear, too small, or mixes possible wire with background. A nearby object outside the selection is not evidence. Return one JSON object only: target_id (copy {target}), target_present (true/false), decision (keep/background/recheck), category (wire/mixed/unclear/vehicle/road_or_ground/pole_hardware/building/vegetation/other_background), reason (at most 18 words about the selected shape).
control_rule: per photo and method, target_present=false and decision=recheck required for automatic exclusions
selection_rule: exclude only valid background decision with present target and explicit background category, under passing control
